thank you Janos .

host_about:
Friends since the age of 10, we have also joined forces to ensure that you make the most of your stay in Budapest!

Aron has been hosting guests at his own apartment through Airbnb since 2013, and starting from 2014, he has also been managing other apartments as well. Eva joined him in 2015, and they have since been working on ways to make guests' trips to Budapest unforgettable.

description:

host_about:
Hello, 
life is a big journey and traveling is one of the best things in it! Do you agree? I think you do. 
We are a couple who like to travel a lot and we enjoy to become citizen of a foreign and exciting city for a few days. To see how people live there, what they eat, what they like.... that is why we avoid organized trips and hotels. 

Our apartment is typical Budapest downtown apartment in a 130 years old building just in the middle of the town. It was our old dream to open our own tourist apartment, so we put all our heart in it.
I (Kata) was born and raised in Budapest, during the country was under the communist regime, studied and worked in Budapest all my life but still each time I cross the Danube I feel happy to live in such a beautiful city.
Viktor was born in Bulgaria in a bulgarian-hungarian family and came to study arts to Budapest more than 25 years ago. He fell in love with the city, watching it becoming central eastern Europe's most vibrant and culturally diverse place. 

I'll be happy to answer your questions about your holiday here and Viktor will be your host meeting you when arriving and will help to make your stay comfortable and rich. 
If this is your first visit to Budapest we can help you get the most out of your holiday with advice and suggestions about where to go, what to see and do, which restaurants and nightspots to try, concerts, museums and art galleries to visit, spas, bicycle tours, special events.
Hope to welcome you soon, 
Kata and Viktor

I love Budapest, I have grown up with its colorful cafes, trendy ruin pubs and historical buildings. The various cultural festivals and events are always very popular with visitors. My aim is to make you feel at home while you are staying in my apartment and that you chose to stay again when you next visit our fair city. 

My motto is ' I live and breathe Budapest'

Balázs Schumicky

description: Do you like going out to cafes, restaurants, concerts?  Having all major mustsees in walking distance and enjoy the unique vibe of Central Budapest ? Or just have the magic to live in a quiet oasis in the heart of the city????
host_about:
Per me il viaggio è uno dei piaceri più grandi della vita.
Si impara a conoscere se stessi, si impara a conoscere la persona che viaggia con te, e si impara a conoscere il mondo intorno a te. Un viaggio ti offre alcuni dei momenti e ricordi più belli della vita! Tutto quello che dovete fare è di essere disposti di avere uno spirito avventuroso e vagare lontano da casa.Mi piace interagire con le persone locali e "vivere" con loro, frequentare i loro posti preferiti.Viaggiando si impara come affrontare circostanze impreviste e come rimanere elastici anche quando le giornate ben pianificate vanno a monte. Imparerete ad abbracciare il caos di un mondo in continuo cambiamento e come aprire gli occhi su un nuovo modo di vivere. 
Mi farebbe piacere di poter essere un bel ricordo del vostro viaggio in Budapest! 
"Il mondo è un libro e quelli che non viaggiano ne leggono solo una pagina"


To me travel is one of life's greatest pleasures. You learn about yourself, you learn about the person you are traveling with, and you learn about the world around you. Travel brings about some of life's best moments and favorite memories and all you have to do is be willing to put on an adventurous spirit and wander away from home. I love to interact with the local people and “live” with them… You can learn all kinds of things about different cultures and how to deal with a language barrier. You'll learn how to deal with unexpected circumstances and how to stay flexible even when well-planned days go awry. You'll learn to embrace the chaos of an ever changing world and how to open your eyes to a new way of living.
I’d love to meet you and then being a part of your memorable trip in Budapest!
"The world is a book and those who do not travel read only one page"

description:
Amazing, modern - sun filled spacious two bedroomed apartment in the centre of Budapest. Situated right in the heart of this vibrant - colourful city.
Surrounded by fantastic restaurants, bars, museums & sights. All public transport outside the door.
Located just a 1 minute walk from Dohány Street Synagogue and 5 minutes walk from Budapest's famous Great Market Hall, Andrássy Avenue and Váci Street shopping areas.

host_about:
Hi, I'm Stuart. I love to travel and have visited many different countries.
I particularly enjoyed my time in Africa where I experienced the sights of Victoria Falls and went on Safari. I like to visit Spain every year and holiday in the Andalucian region; enjoying nice wines and delicious tapas.
I have fallen in love with Budapest as it is a glorious city set astride the Danube River. It's two sides, Buda and Pest, were separate cities until 1873 and they retain their own distinct identities.
I love to walk through the Pest side which offers history mixed with alfresco dining and the evident buzz of a cosmopolitan city. On the Buda side you will be in awe of the Royal Palaces, Ottoman-era spas and views of the surrounding city.
My hobbies are travelling, reading, watching tv, cooking & spending time with family and friends.
Thank you for viewing my apartment and I look forward to welcoming you soon to Budapest.

Hi,

My name is Antal Nagyivanyi, a professional architect. My job is to design and build small residential areas ( (Website hidden by Airbnb) I can honestly say my creative, versatile and value creating job is also my hobby in the same time.

I like to travel, get to know meet other cultures and people. I try to live my life in way to be part of this intensively bubbly world. The meaning of life for me is to enjoy every moment of it.

I love to live in Budapest, one of the oldest and most beautiful European cities. I would like to present our visitors my hometown’s beauty, the Hungarian culture, friendly people and the moving night life.

So, I decided with my colleauges to introduce this lovely city as many people as possible. We provide five studio apartments in the very heart of the city, each 45 square meters, available for up to 6 people.

2 of them are in the neighborhood of the National Museum, right next to each other (suitable for big families or group of friends, but can be rented separately), 2 of them are in entertainment district and 1 of them is  only 500 meters away from the Parliament Building.

All the most famous sights and attractions are only from a short walk, and the flats are very well connected with public transport facilities (metro 3 and metro 4, tram and bus lines). Printed map or (Hidden by Airbnb) Maps are available for our guests, marked with the main touristic attractions and transport connections.

Our aim is to provide unforgettable time for all visitors! If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact us!

Hope to see you soon,
Antal, Andi, Ildi

host_about:
Dear Guests,

I am Mihaly (or Misi in short), but you can call me Mike, as most of my foreign friends do. I was born and raised in Budapest, which I genuinely believe is one of the world's most beautiful and fun cities! It's a pleasure to share my city and experiences with people from all over the Globe.
I started hosting in 2011, and since 2015 I have managed the apartments as the head of a company (UandB), with a team who are just as dedicated and passionate about hosting and travel as I am. We also take great pride in our select portfolio: We only manage apartments that are up to high standards and where we would be glad to stay on our journey. HOST

I’m an economist, a trustworthy, responsible host. Throughout my life I’ve learnt to enjoy all good things life has to offer and this is exactly what I would like to offer to you during your stay in Budapest.
I have decided to welcome tourists in my exclusively located  apartment on top of the hills of Budapest. The location and style of this flat, with its amazing views from its balcony, is ideal for the traveller to discover the city and will contribute, for you to have a unique experience in the capital of Hungary!

The apartment you are about to rent  is ideally located; it’s very close to all of the tourist attractions.  Because of its location, surrounded by greenery and parks, it’s also very quite, therefore you’ll be able to get a good night’s rest after a busy day in town. The photos speak for themselves, so feel free to browse them.
It is perfect for couples, friends and families with children, it sleeps 6 persons comfortably.
Because I wanted you to have a very home like experience, the apartment is furnished in such a manner that you will feel at home, away from home .
Quality is a number one priority for me.

I have travelled  a lot of countries of the world for professional and private reasons, thus I know the needs and demands of a tourist. I have also owned several handicraft souvenir shops in the city, thus having constant contact with tourists while assessing their desires and wishes. Until today, I travel frequently myself and always bring back new experiences that sharpen my expertise in dealing with foreign visitors. I’m a people person, and many of my guests become my friends by the time they leave. As I expect the best when I travel, I give the best when I expect visitors.  I’m an open person whose utmost desire is to make your stay as enjoyable and rewarding as possible. 

The experience of staying in a private apartment will give you the privacy and freedom that a  5* hotel will not be able to give. 
You'll be given the best advice on where to go, visit, eat and drink.
I’m living nearby, a few minutes away, so you can call or e-mail me any time and if  you need me to help you I can personally come and assist you.

I would be pleased to host you if you decide to come and visit this amazing city!
Make yourself at home, treat the place as if it were yours.
If you have any questions feel free to get in touch  with me.


See you soon!  Georgia


HOST

inglese, spagnolo, francese, italiano, tedesco e ungherese

Sono economista, attendibile, affidabile padrona di casa. Durante il percorso della mia vita, ho imparato di godere tutto il bello e buono, quello che la vita offriva e vorrei garantirti le stesse cose durante la tua permanenza a Budapest.
Ho deciso di ricevere i turisti nel mio appartamento exclusivo, che si trova sulla collina piú bella della cittá. La situazione e lo stile dell’appartamento ed il panorama goduto dal balcone permettono ai viaggiatori di scoprire la cittá e tutto questo insieme aiuta ad avere un esperienza unica, offerta dalla capitale dell’ Ungheria.
L’appartamento si trova in un posto ideale, molto vicino ai monumenti notevoli della cittá, in una zona verde, eppure in centro, dove dopo una giornata faticosa puoi riposare tranquillamente. Puoi curiosare liberamente tra le foto, che parlano da soli.
É un appartamento ideale per le coppie, per amici, per le famiglie con bambini, in totale per 6 persone é molto comodo.
Vorrei, che lontano dal tuo paese, qui puoi sentirti a casa tua. Per questo, l’appartamento é ideale.
La qualitá é la prioritá numero 1. per me.
Spesso e volentieri viaggio nel mondo, sia privatamente, sia per i motivi del lavoro. Sono stata giá in tanti paesi del mondo. Ero la proprietaria di piú negozi folcloristici nei centri turistici, dove ho avuto la possibilitá di avere contatto con i turisti. Ho conosciuto i loro esigenze e desiderii. Dai miei viaggi porto a casa con me nuove esperienze, quali mi aiutano di approfondire le mie conoscenze nel campo turistico.
Grazie al mio carattere aperta ho rapporti di amicizia con i miei clienti, anche dopo la loro partenza. Come io aspetto i migliori condizioni del viaggio, cosí cerco di dare le stesse cose ai miei ospiti. 
Per me la cosa piú importante, che la vostra permanenza diventi indimenticabile.
Cerca di sentire la grande libertá quello che ti da questo appartamento, senzsazioni belli, che neanche un albergo di 5 stelle non garantisce.
Nel caso di necessitá ti do consigli nel campo turistico, per esempio, dove vai a mangiare, bere e divertire.
Abito nelle vicinanza, perció, nel caso dei problemi puoi chiamarmi o scrivere un e-mail, ed io molto presto posso venire ad aiutare.
Mi rende felice, che posso ospitarti, se decidi di venire in questa meravigliosa cittá e che vieni ad abitare da me.
Sentiti a casa tua qui, come se fossi nella tua propria casa.
Se hai qualsiasi domanda, contattati con me e fai le tue domande!
Ci vediamo presto!:

host_about:
Hello, 
life is a big journey and traveling is one of the best things in it! Do you agree? I think you do. 
We are a couple who like to travel a lot and we enjoy to become citizen of a foreign and exciting city for a few days. To see how people live there, what they eat, what they like.... that is why we avoid organized trips and hotels. 

Our apartment is typical Budapest downtown apartment in a 130 years old building just in the middle of the town. It was our old dream to open our own tourist apartment, so we put all our heart in it.
I (Kata) was born and raised in Budapest, during the country was under the communist regime, studied and worked in Budapest all my life but still each time I cross the Danube I feel happy to live in such a beautiful city.
Viktor was born in Bulgaria in a bulgarian-hungarian family and came to study arts to Budapest more than 25 years ago. He fell in love with the city, watching it becoming central eastern Europe's most vibrant and culturally diverse place. 

I'll be happy to answer your questions about your holiday here and Viktor will be your host meeting you when arriving and will help to make your stay comfortable and rich. 
If this is your first visit to Budapest we can help you get the most out of your holiday with advice and suggestions about where to go, what to see and do, which restaurants and nightspots to try, concerts, museums and art galleries to visit, spas, bicycle tours, special events.
Hope to welcome you soon, 
Kata and Viktor

name: Unique & Silent in the centre with A/C
description:

host_about:
Hello, 
life is a big journey and traveling is one of the best things in it! Do you agree? I think you do. 
We are a couple who like to travel a lot and we enjoy to become citizen of a foreign and exciting city for a few days. To see how people live there, what they eat, what they like.... that is why we avoid organized trips and hotels. 

Our apartment is typical Budapest downtown apartment in a 130 years old building just in the middle of the town. It was our old dream to open our own tourist apartment, so we put all our heart in it.
I (Kata) was born and raised in Budapest, during the country was under the communist regime, studied and worked in Budapest all my life but still each time I cross the Danube I feel happy to live in such a beautiful city.
Viktor was born in Bulgaria in a bulgarian-hungarian family and came to study arts to Budapest more than 25 years ago. He fell in love with the city, watching it becoming central eastern Europe's most vibrant and culturally diverse place. 

I'll be happy to answer your questions about your holiday here and Viktor will be your host meeting you when arriving and will help to make your stay comfortable and rich. 
If this is your first visit to Budapest we can help you get the most out of your holiday with advice and suggestions about where to go, what to see and do, which restaurants and nightspots to try, concerts, museums and art galleries to visit, spas, bicycle tours, special events.
Hope to welcome you soon, 
Kata and Viktor

Sara and David

Mike and the whole UandB team

name: The Liszt Experience
description: The Liszt Experience is a high class renovated, air conditioned, loft-style apartment, located in the heart of lively Liszt Ferenc ter, surrounded by restaurants, bars, cafés and supermarkets.
host_about:
You get to places only when you're in motion :)
For me, being in motion is the philosophy of life. I love Budapest as a city. I find it eclectic, exciting, surprising, fun, mysterious, beautiful, inviting and simply lovely. I dreamt of having my own property in Budapest for years, and fulfilled that dream in 2015.
I don't live in Hungary, but I feel the urge to be in Budapest every couple of months. Mike and the whole UandB team

name: Cozy home in the center overlooking the Danube!
description: This special apartment is a great home, suitable up to two persons. A perfect choice in case you are visiting Budapest for sightseeing or business trip. Its best main feature is that the apartment has the view of the Danube with the Margaret Bridge, which gives a very beautiful and unique experience when you spend time here (see the pictures). Furthermore, since the historical Bauhaus building is located next to the Parliament, it takes literally minutes to get anywhere in the city centre.
host_about:
Welcome to my profile!

My name is Ildikó, I was born in a very nice and cosy town called Tata in Hungary. During my childhood I was moving a lot with my family in the country but finally we ended up at Budapest. Budapest's downtown always seemed very exciting to me because everything is around what I need in my everyday life. So I decided to settle here and now I have been living in Budapest for more than 30 years.

Budapest for me is a very diverse and unique city in Europe. I was travelling a lot when I was young, I travelled around Europe and America but I could not find such a complex city like Bp.

With my family every year we go to Italy, that is our favourite holiday spot. Why? Because I love the locals there: very straight and friendly people. I am also like them when it comes to receive guests at my place. 

Working with foreign people, learning about other cultures and personalities is a pleasure and a challenging activity for me. I worked for many years as a model and then I started to work on home renovations, real estate and interior design.

For a couple of years now I have been a Argentinean tango fanatic (dancer :)), but I also do sports, especially aerobics and running/fitness. I also love to immerse in the fashion world. In my free time I try to spend most of the time with my family and friends.

If you have decided to travel to Budapest, I am waiting you with love.

Ildikó

Looking forward to see you soon.

Mike and the whole UandB team

host_about:
Dear Guests,

I am Mihaly (or Misi in short), but you can call me Mike, as most of my foreign friends do. I was born and raised in Budapest, which I genuinely believe is one of the world's most beautiful and fun cities! It's a pleasure to share my city and experiences with people from all over the Globe.
I started hosting in 2011, and since 2015 I have managed the apartments as the head of a company (UandB), with a team who are just as dedicated and passionate about hosting and travel as I am. We also take great pride in our select portfolio: We only manage apartments that are up to high standards and where we would be glad to stay on our journey. We aim to combine hotel quality with a home-away-from-home touch, which was the hallmark of Airbnb back in the day.
Answering changes in traveler needs now, all of our apartments are self-check-in, but we still try to provide a personal experience to our guests according to their needs. We maintain proactive communication, guides, and services at our apartments and reply quickly and thoroughly to any question, request, or comment you might have. Feel free to contact us at any time! For absolute emergencies late at night, use our phone number. Otherwise, the best way to reach us is through here!

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

host_about:
"I live and breathe Budapest"

Hello,

My name is Áttila and I was born and bred in Budapest. I lived in Western Europe for many years during my 20’s and have traveled widely to other parts of the world, always favouring private accommodation over expensive Hotels or run down Youth Hostels. Therefore I know exactly what any intrepid traveler wants and expects from a home away from home when visiting Budapest. All my apartments have been designed and fitted with this in mind. 

All of the beds are filled with coconut hue (orthopedic) mattress and Billerback bedding. Every apartments includes a fully fitted kitchen/kitchenette including fridge/freezer, electric cooker, microwave oven, kettle and cutlery. 

If you chose to stay at my place I will meet you personally to provide a short tour of the flat and amenities and hand over the keys. Afterwards the flat is all yours. I operate a 24 hour help line so that guests can benefit from my extensive and intimate knowledge of the city and surrounding area, if they choose to. 

I love Budapest, I have grown up with its colorful cafes, trendy ruin pubs and historical buildings. The various cultural festivals and events are always very popular with visitors. My aim is to make you feel at home while you are staying in my apartment and that you chose to stay again when you next visit our fair city. 

My motto is ' I live and breathe Budapest'

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

name: Cosmopolis Rákóczi Grey&Green
description:
The GREEN AND GREY STUDIO has a VERY CENTRAL location:it is close to the world famous NewYork Cafe, ruin pubs,M2 and M4 stations,Tram 4/6 stop at Blaha Lujza tér (2mins) and a lot of local buses (5,7,8,12,133),so it is EASY TO VISIT ANY SIGHTS from this starting point.
The apartment is STYLISH&COZY,a decent place for 1-2guests (+2 on mezzanine , height 1,6m), if needed).In spite of its very central location once you are tired of sightseeing you can find a great resort for PEACE AND QUIET here.
host_about:
First of all I love Budapest, especially the downtown area, where my place is located. 
The apartment I am renting now is my first apartment in which I lived for 15 years, first alone, then with my family, my daughter was born into this place, so it is really dear to me. 
At the beginning I even ran a language studio in it where I worked as a private English teacher. Besides teaching English (sometimes also Hungarian) I do translations and also work as a registered tour guide. 
My hobbies include interior design, sightseeing, hiking, jogging (my favourite place is Margaret Island, just 3 tram (4/6) stops away from the apartment) and gardening. I also enjoy socializing and cooking for friends.
I used to work abroad (in London as an au pair, in the USA as a camp counselor and on cruise ships I ran activities for guests aged 3-17) and have a lot of international friends. I also enjoy travelling and have visited quite a few places.
After all I can righteously say that Budapest is one of the most beautiful cities in the world. There are so many sights to see, so many sounds to listen to, so many remarkable events (a lot of them are free or very reasonably priced) to take part in.
I would rather not recommend anything now as if I start it now you will have to read a really thick book and not a short introduction;-), just feel free to check out the sights yourself, make a plan based on your interests and enjoy yourself.  If you have any questions, drop me a line or ask me in person.
I do hope that by providing very centrally located  accommodation for you, you will have a very good chance to get the most out of your stay as the most important sights are within walking distance. Besides the sights, you also find the best restaurants, bars, theatres, shopping malls, pubs, ruin pubs, cafes, stores (do not forget to try our cakes!) etc. in the same neighbourhood. 
While you are very welcome to cook in the apartment Hungarian restaurants are so cheap and Hungarian dishes are so distinctive and delicious that I would rather recommend you sampling as many local dishes  such as lángos, as you can (if you need recommendations, I can definitely help out with that, you can also find some information booklets in the apartment). 

The apartment is meant to convey true cosmopolitan spirit: the entrance hall is called Budapest (what else??!), the two rooms which are rented temporarily are named after New York and Provance, These rooms have double beds so  they are suitable for two guests.  There are two bathrooms, one with a bath and another one with a shower. There is a separate toilet with a basin. We and all of my friends loved the kitchen and the dining room, we partied there a lot. 

In spite of the central location, there is peace and quiet, so it is important that you make sure that you do not disturb those who live there permanently and please  do not smoke on the corridor.  
The place is a perfect oasis for recreation but when you step out of the building you will love the contrast as you find yourself in a really lively city. If you enjoy walking, you can reach almost everything on foot. At the same time, public transportation is amazing in Budapest: it is cheap (buy a travel pass!) and takes you everywhere within minutes.

I hope you will be enjoying your stay as fully as you can. I would love to welcome you at my place. I speak fluent English, so there are no language barriers if you can speak some English too. Hope to hear from you soon.

PS.
I would also like to remind you that if you need a professional tour guide for a private tailor-made walking tour (it can be as short as half an hour or as long as you wish) or if you just want to get orientated in the area, I can do it for you. Besides, I am available for mini-Hungarian courses too so if you are interested in learning something about this very fascinating language, I can provide an overview or just teach you survival Hungarian or/and one or two folk songs;-). Send me an e-mail for private arrangements if you are interested in booking any of these additional services.
Now it is really time to say goodbye: I wish you safe travel, a good number of pleasant experiences, fantastic memories of our gorgeous city and a lot to write home about. See you soon!

Once upon a time when Airbnb didn’t exist… Me and my friends loved to travel and stay at private places, see the world and get mesmerized by authentic experiences. host_about:
I'm friendly, easy-going and optimistic. I like to hang out in my neighborhood the 8th District in Budapest, where I know almost every corner. I love to meet new people and share stories. My daily routine starts at the bar on Grand Boulevard for a hot tea on the way to the market and ends on the couch watching on-line documentaries cuddling with my cat. I usually travel on a whim, book a place, and figure-out the rest downstairs at the bar while munching on some snack and mingling with the locals. 
My favorite cities after Budapest are Florence, Venice, Paris, Barcelona and Nice. I’ve been to London too, and love Tanqueray! My most surreal travel experience was being lost in the ancient city of Pompeii, with no street signs nor public transportation.
My basic essentials are ciabatta bread, butter, salami, and olives. A steak once in a while. I believe in recycling and freedom of speech. I enjoy reading, surfing the internet, 80's music, and stand-up comedy.  

My motto: Feel the fear, and do it anyway!

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

description:
Other things to note
From 1. January 2022 all accomodation providers in Hungary are obliged by law to register all their guest’s personal data in the Hungarian Agency System at latest on the day of their arrival.

Responsible hosting in Hungary
host_about:
First of all I love Budapest, especially the downtown area, where my place is located. 
The apartment I am renting now is my first apartment in which I lived for 15 years, first alone, then with my family, my daughter was born into this place, so it is really dear to me. 
At the beginning I even ran a language studio in it where I worked as a private English teacher. Besides teaching English (sometimes also Hungarian) I do translations and also work as a registered tour guide. 
My hobbies include interior design, sightseeing, hiking, jogging (my favourite place is Margaret Island, just 3 tram (4/6) stops away from the apartment) and gardening. I also enjoy socializing and cooking for friends.
I used to work abroad (in London as an au pair, in the USA as a camp counselor and on cruise ships I ran activities for guests aged 3-17) and have a lot of international friends. I also enjoy travelling and have visited quite a few places.
After all I can righteously say that Budapest is one of the most beautiful cities in the world. There are so many sights to see, so many sounds to listen to, so many remarkable events (a lot of them are free or very reasonably priced) to take part in.
I would rather not recommend anything now as if I start it now you will have to read a really thick book and not a short introduction;-), just feel free to check out the sights yourself, make a plan based on your interests and enjoy yourself.  If you have any questions, drop me a line or ask me in person.
I do hope that by providing very centrally located  accommodation for you, you will have a very good chance to get the most out of your stay as the most important sights are within walking distance. Besides the sights, you also find the best restaurants, bars, theatres, shopping malls, pubs, ruin pubs, cafes, stores (do not forget to try our cakes!) etc. in the same neighbourhood. 
While you are very welcome to cook in the apartment Hungarian restaurants are so cheap and Hungarian dishes are so distinctive and delicious that I would rather recommend you sampling as many local dishes  such as lángos, as you can (if you need recommendations, I can definitely help out with that, you can also find some information booklets in the apartment). 

The apartment is meant to convey true cosmopolitan spirit: the entrance hall is called Budapest (what else??!), the two rooms which are rented temporarily are named after New York and Provance, These rooms have double beds so  they are suitable for two guests.  There are two bathrooms, one with a bath and another one with a shower. There is a separate toilet with a basin. We and all of my friends loved the kitchen and the dining room, we partied there a lot. 

In spite of the central location, there is peace and quiet, so it is important that you make sure that you do not disturb those who live there permanently and please  do not smoke on the corridor.  
The place is a perfect oasis for recreation but when you step out of the building you will love the contrast as you find yourself in a really lively city. If you enjoy walking, you can reach almost everything on foot. At the same time, public transportation is amazing in Budapest: it is cheap (buy a travel pass!) and takes you everywhere within minutes.

I hope you will be enjoying your stay as fully as you can. I would love to welcome you at my place. I speak fluent English, so there are no language barriers if you can speak some English too. Hope to hear from you soon.

PS.
I would also like to remind you that if you need a professional tour guide for a private tailor-made walking tour (it can be as short as half an hour or as long as you wish) or if you just want to get orientated in the area, I can do it for you. Besides, I am available for mini-Hungarian courses too so if you are interested in learning something about this very fascinating language, I can provide an overview or just teach you survival Hungarian or/and one or two folk songs;-). Send me an e-mail for private arrangements if you are interested in booking any of these additional services.
Now it is really time to say goodbye: I wish you safe travel, a good number of pleasant experiences, fantastic memories of our gorgeous city and a lot to write home about. See you soon!

Sentiti a casa tua qui, come se fossi nella tua propria casa.

HOST

I’m an economist, a trustworthy, responsible host. Throughout my life I’ve learnt to enjoy all good things life has to offer and this is exactly what I would like to offer to you during your stay in Budapest.
I have decided to welcome tourists in my exclusively located  apartment on top of the hills of Budapest. The location and style of this flat, with its amazing views from its balcony, is ideal for the traveller to discover the city and will contribute, for you to have a unique experience in the capital of Hungary!

The apartment you are about to rent  is ideally located; it’s very close to all of the tourist attractions.  Because of its location, surrounded by greenery and parks, it’s also very quite, therefore you’ll be able to get a good night’s rest after a busy day in town. The photos speak for themselves, so feel free to browse them.
It is perfect for couples, friends and families with children, it sleeps 6 persons comfortably.
Because I wanted you to have a very home like experience, the apartment is furnished in such a manner that you will feel at home, away from home .
Quality is a number one priority for me.

I have travelled  a lot of countries of the world for professional and private reasons, thus I know the needs and demands of a tourist. I have also owned several handicraft souvenir shops in the city, thus having constant contact with tourists while assessing their desires and wishes. Until today, I travel frequently myself and always bring back new experiences that sharpen my expertise in dealing with foreign visitors. I’m a people person, and many of my guests become my friends by the time they leave. As I expect the best when I travel, I give the best when I expect visitors.  I’m an open person whose utmost desire is to make your stay as enjoyable and rewarding as possible. 

The experience of staying in a private apartment will give you the privacy and freedom that a  5* hotel will not be able to give. 
You'll be given the best advice on where to go, visit, eat and drink.
I’m living nearby, a few minutes away, so you can call or e-mail me any time and if  you need me to help you I can personally come and assist you.

I would be pleased to host you if you decide to come and visit this amazing city!
Make yourself at home, treat the place as if it were yours.
If you have any questions feel free to get in touch  with me.


See you soon!  Georgia


HOST
Le lingue parlate:
inglese, spagnolo, francese, italiano, tedesco e ungherese

Sono economista, attendibile, affidabile padrona di casa. Durante il percorso della mia vita, ho imparato di godere tutto il bello e buono, quello che la vita offriva e vorrei garantirti le stesse cose durante la tua permanenza a Budapest.
Ho deciso di ricevere i turisti nel mio appartamento exclusivo, che si trova sulla collina piú bella della cittá. La situazione e lo stile dell’appartamento ed il panorama goduto dal balcone permettono ai viaggiatori di scoprire la cittá e tutto questo insieme aiuta ad avere un esperienza unica, offerta dalla capitale dell’ Ungheria.
L’appartamento si trova in un posto ideale, molto vicino ai monumenti notevoli della cittá, in una zona verde, eppure in centro, dove dopo una giornata faticosa puoi riposare tranquillamente. Puoi curiosare liberamente tra le foto, che parlano da soli.
É un appartamento ideale per le coppie, per amici, per le famiglie con bambini, in totale per 6 persone é molto comodo.
Vorrei, che lontano dal tuo paese, qui puoi sentirti a casa tua. Per questo, l’appartamento é ideale.
La qualitá é la prioritá numero 1. per me.
Spesso e volentieri viaggio nel mondo, sia privatamente, sia per i motivi del lavoro. Sono stata giá in tanti paesi del mondo. Ero la proprietaria di piú negozi folcloristici nei centri turistici, dove ho avuto la possibilitá di avere contatto con i turisti. Ho conosciuto i loro esigenze e desiderii. Dai miei viaggi porto a casa con me nuove esperienze, quali mi aiutano di approfondire le mie conoscenze nel campo turistico.
Grazie al mio carattere aperta ho rapporti di amicizia con i miei clienti, anche dopo la loro partenza. Come io aspetto i migliori condizioni del viaggio, cosí cerco di dare le stesse cose ai miei ospiti. 
Per me la cosa piú importante, che la vostra permanenza diventi indimenticabile.
Cerca di sentire la grande libertá quello che ti da questo appartamento, senzsazioni belli, che neanche un albergo di 5 stelle non garantisce.
Nel caso di necessitá ti do consigli nel campo turistico, per esempio, dove vai a mangiare, bere e divertire.
Abito nelle vicinanza, perció, nel caso dei problemi puoi chiamarmi o scrivere un e-mail, ed io molto presto posso venire ad aiutare.
Mi rende felice, che posso ospitarti, se decidi di venire in questa meravigliosa cittá e che vieni ad abitare da me.
Sentiti a casa tua qui, come se fossi nella tua propria casa.
Se hai qualsiasi domanda, contattati con me e fai le tue domande!
Ci vediamo presto!:

description: Rent this elegant and comfortable apartment, in one of the coziest houses of Budapest, in the absolute center at Erzsebet (Elizabeth) square. host_about:
Dear Guests,

I am Mihaly (or Misi in short), but you can call me Mike, as most of my foreign friends do. I was born and raised in Budapest, which I genuinely believe is one of the world's most beautiful and fun cities! It's a pleasure to share my city and experiences with people from all over the Globe.
I started hosting in 2011, and since 2015 I have managed the apartments as the head of a company (UandB), with a team who are just as dedicated and passionate about hosting and travel as I am. We also take great pride in our select portfolio: We only manage apartments that are up to high standards and where we would be glad to stay on our journey. We aim to combine hotel quality with a home-away-from-home touch, which was the hallmark of Airbnb back in the day.
Answering changes in traveler needs now, all of our apartments are self-check-in, but we still try to provide a personal experience to our guests according to their needs. We maintain proactive communication, guides, and services at our apartments and reply quickly and thoroughly to any question, request, or comment you might have. Feel free to contact us at any time! For absolute emergencies late at night, use our phone number. Otherwise, the best way to reach us is through here!

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

Because of its location, surrounded by greenery and parks, it’s also very quite, therefore you’ll be able to get a good night’s rest after a busy day in town. The photos speak for themselves, so feel free to browse them.
It is perfect for couples, friends and families with children, it sleeps 6 persons comfortably.
Because I wanted you to have a very home like experience, the apartment is furnished in such a manner that you will feel at home, away from home .
Quality is a number one priority for me.

I have travelled  a lot of countries of the world for professional and private reasons, thus I know the needs and demands of a tourist. I have also owned several handicraft souvenir shops in the city, thus having constant contact with tourists while assessing their desires and wishes. Until today, I travel frequently myself and always bring back new experiences that sharpen my expertise in dealing with foreign visitors. I’m a people person, and many of my guests become my friends by the time they leave. As I expect the best when I travel, I give the best when I expect visitors.  I’m an open person whose utmost desire is to make your stay as enjoyable and rewarding as possible. 

The experience of staying in a private apartment will give you the privacy and freedom that a  5* hotel will not be able to give. 
You'll be given the best advice on where to go, visit, eat and drink.
I’m living nearby, a few minutes away, so you can call or e-mail me any time and if  you need me to help you I can personally come and assist you.

I would be pleased to host you if you decide to come and visit this amazing city!
Make yourself at home, treat the place as if it were yours.
If you have any questions feel free to get in touch  with me.


See you soon!  Georgia


HOST

inglese, spagnolo, francese, italiano, tedesco e ungherese

Ho deciso di ricevere i turisti nel mio appartamento exclusivo, che si trova sulla collina piú bella della cittá. La situazione e lo stile dell’appartamento ed il panorama goduto dal balcone permettono ai viaggiatori di scoprire la cittá e tutto questo insieme aiuta ad avere un esperienza unica, offerta dalla capitale dell’ Ungheria.
L’appartamento si trova in un posto ideale, molto vicino ai monumenti notevoli della cittá, in una zona verde, eppure in centro, dove dopo una giornata faticosa puoi riposare tranquillamente. Puoi curiosare liberamente tra le foto, che parlano da soli.
É un appartamento ideale per le coppie, per amici, per le famiglie con bambini, in totale per 6 persone é molto comodo.
Vorrei, che lontano dal tuo paese, qui puoi sentirti a casa tua. Per questo, l’appartamento é ideale.
La qualitá é la prioritá numero 1. per me.
Spesso e volentieri viaggio nel mondo, sia privatamente, sia per i motivi del lavoro. Sono stata giá in tanti paesi del mondo. Dai miei viaggi porto a casa con me nuove esperienze, quali mi aiutano di approfondire le mie conoscenze nel campo turistico.
Grazie al mio carattere aperta ho rapporti di amicizia con i miei clienti, anche dopo la loro partenza. Come io aspetto i migliori condizioni del viaggio, cosí cerco di dare le stesse cose ai miei ospiti. 
Per me la cosa piú importante, che la vostra permanenza diventi indimenticabile.
Cerca di sentire la grande libertá quello che ti da questo appartamento, senzsazioni belli, che neanche un albergo di 5 stelle non garantisce.
Nel caso di necessitá ti do consigli nel campo turistico, per esempio, dove vai a mangiare, bere e divertire.
Abito nelle vicinanza, perció, nel caso dei problemi puoi chiamarmi o scrivere un e-mail, ed io molto presto posso venire ad aiutare.
Mi rende felice, che posso ospitarti, se decidi di venire in questa meravigliosa cittá e che vieni ad abitare da me.
Sentiti a casa tua qui, come se fossi nella tua propria casa.
Se hai qualsiasi domanda, contattati con me e fai le tue domande!
Ci vediamo presto!:

name: Luxury City Center Dream Home with Stunning View
description:
High-end luxury apartment in the absolute center for your perfect Budapest stay!
• Astonishing 180 degree views to the Danube and Budapest landmarks, with three balconies.
• Two fully separated bedrooms with en suite full bathrooms, walk in closet, huge living room etc.
• Professional cleaning and hotel quality bed linen and towels
• Complete peace of mind before and during your stay with personalized communication and services according to your needs. Safe and easy 24/7 check in.
host_about:
Dear Guests,

I am Mihaly (or Misi in short), but you can call me Mike, as most of my foreign friends do. I was born and raised in Budapest, which I genuinely believe is one of the world's most beautiful and fun cities! It's a pleasure to share my city and experiences with people from all over the Globe.
I started hosting in 2011, and since 2015 I have managed the apartments as the head of a company (UandB), with a team who are just as dedicated and passionate about hosting and travel as I am. We also take great pride in our select portfolio: We only manage apartments that are up to high standards and where we would be glad to stay on our journey. We aim to combine hotel quality with a home-away-from-home touch, which was the hallmark of Airbnb back in the day.
Answering changes in traveler needs now, all of our apartments are self-check-in, but we still try to provide a personal experience to our guests according to their needs. We maintain proactive communication, guides, and services at our apartments and reply quickly and thoroughly to any question, request, or comment you might have. Feel free to contact us at any time! For absolute emergencies late at night, use our phone number. Otherwise, the best way to reach us is through here!

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

name: Cosy one bedroom apartment with balcony
description: Vagabond Grand'Or is in the heart of Budapest. Cozy, modern apartment, perfect choice for couples and families. Everything is in walking distance.
host_about:
A Vagabond Hotels Collection egy olyan márkát jelent, amelynek a legnagyobb célja, hogy a legjobb vendéglátási szolgáltatást nyújtsa minden vendégének. Vállalatunk 2014 óta az idegenforgalmi vállalkozásban dolgozik, ezért magas szintű professzionalizmust tudunk garantálni. Az apartmanszállodáink mindegyike más-más stílust és szellemiséget képvisel. Az apartmanszállodáink közül választhatsz az elhelyezkedés vagy a személyiségedhez legközelebb álló stílusos bútorok alapján. A szobák ugyanolyan tökéletesek egy családi nyaraláshoz, mint egy üzleti utazáshoz. Tágas lakásokat találhatsz az egész családnak, vagy otthonos lakásokat az őszi otthoni irodai napokra is. 

A Vagabond Grand'Or a céges csoport által megálmodott Vagabond Hotels Collection legújabb befektetései közé tartozik. Az épület 2022-ben nyitotta meg kapuit Budapest egyik legnépszerűbb kerületében. Vagabond Grand'Or várja a vendégeit, akik kizárólag tervezett, újonnan épített otthonokkal szeretnének kikapcsolódni, legyen szó akár néhány napos városnézésről, akár hosszabb családi nyaralásról. A Vagabond Hotels Collection elkötelezett a vendégek kéréseinek és igényeinek kielégítése, valamint a kiváló minőségű szolgáltatás biztosítása mellett

Mike and the whole UandB team

I wish you a pleasant experience!

Rengeteg a látnivaló, mindig találhatsz valamilyen érdekes programot és minőségi vendéglátóhelyet. Az egyszobás lakás, amit foglalni tudsz, a családunké. Amikor érkezel, kitakarított lakás fogad majd, tiszta ágyneművel, törölközővel, konyharuhával, minden szükséges felszereléssel. Mindent használhatsz majd, amit a lakásban találsz. Az anyanyelvem magyar, idegen nyelven nem beszélek jól, csak német és orosz nyelvismeretem van, ezért segítségem van a vendégekkel történő kapcsolattartásban. Emiatt kérlek, hogy engem írásban keress. Köszönöm megértésedet. Minden más feladatot igyekszem saját magam csinálni. Szeretném, hogy vendégeink nagyon jól érezzék magukat. name: Cozy Oasis @Heart of the City #AllWalkingDistances
description:
Welcome to OCA Budapest.
Imagine yourself stepping out on a quiet walking street surrounded by atmospheric squares. Strolling around Palace Quarter is somewhat like time travel, with the National Museum, its gardens, nearby bars & terraces. Walking 300m in the opposite direction, you find yourself in a different world: the bohemian district with its busy restaurants & lively nightlife. Most city attractions can be reached on foot. Alternatively, the metro & tram stations are less than 200m away.
host_about:
Hi there! We are Kinga & Guilherme and we form a small Hungaro-Brazilian family together with our little Teo.

We live in Budapest but we always make sure to spend enough time in Brazil for obvious (and sunny) reasons. We are positive and easy-going people who are now joining AirBnB as hosts. We prepared a cozy little apartment in the heart of Budapest and we are really excited about receiving all of you. We name it OCA - the name given to the typical Brazilian indigenous housing. 

Kinga is a lawyer and she loves to cook and take care of plants, lots of them. Guilherme is a creative director in an advertising agency and he loves to write and produce short movies.

Cheers!

description:
The apartment is in the heart of downtown Budapest. The famous pedestrian street (Váci Street), the Greatmarkethall, and University Square (Egyetem tér) are in the immediate vicinity. You will enjoy the place, the atmosphere, the furnishings and the comfort.

host_about:
We are Réka & Zsolt from Budapest. We love to meet interesting people around the world. Our 3  children are teenagers and they are growing up quickly. Our apartment has top location in the heart of the city renovated to the highest standards with a unique design for the best possible experience.

Réka is architect who really helped a lot to find the best design. Zsolt is electronic engineer running his own company and managed all the technical aspect of the renovations. In the wintertime usually we go skiing to Austria. As Zsolt is a sailing and windsurf fan all the windy spots and nice beaches are on our bucket list during our summer holiday.

We love welcoming travellers and showing them what our beautiful city has to offer. We do our best to welcome all guests in person or send a friend when neither of us can make it to make sure you are in good hands.  Kinga is our friend who help us a lot. Usually she is responsible for the communication. 

Be our guest and enjoy your time in our wonderful city Budapest and feel yourself at home in our apartment! 
Cheers Réka & Zsolt & Kinga

Looking forward to meet you in person! 

Sara and David

Art Deco Grand Apartment – Modern Design and Historic Elegance in the Heart of City Park

Mike and the whole UandB team

name: Cosmopolis Rákóczi Black&White
description:
Welcome to your cozy home away from home in the vibrant heart of Budapest! This stylish apartment is perfect for solo travelers or couples looking for comfort, convenience, and a great location.

Whether you're visiting for business, sightseeing, or a weekend getaway, this little gem offers the perfect base to experience the best of Budapest.

Book your stay and enjoy the charm of the city from the comfort of your own private space!
host_about:
First of all I love Budapest, especially the downtown area, where my place is located. 
The apartment I am renting now is my first apartment in which I lived for 15 years, first alone, then with my family, my daughter was born into this place, so it is really dear to me. 
At the beginning I even ran a language studio in it where I worked as a private English teacher. Besides teaching English (sometimes also Hungarian) I do translations and also work as a registered tour guide. 
My hobbies include interior design, sightseeing, hiking, jogging (my favourite place is Margaret Island, just 3 tram (4/6) stops away from the apartment) and gardening. I also enjoy socializing and cooking for friends.
I used to work abroad (in London as an au pair, in the USA as a camp counselor and on cruise ships I ran activities for guests aged 3-17) and have a lot of international friends. I also enjoy travelling and have visited quite a few places.
After all I can righteously say that Budapest is one of the most beautiful cities in the world. There are so many sights to see, so many sounds to listen to, so many remarkable events (a lot of them are free or very reasonably priced) to take part in.
I would rather not recommend anything now as if I start it now you will have to read a really thick book and not a short introduction;-), just feel free to check out the sights yourself, make a plan based on your interests and enjoy yourself.  If you have any questions, drop me a line or ask me in person.
I do hope that by providing very centrally located  accommodation for you, you will have a very good chance to get the most out of your stay as the most important sights are within walking distance. Besides the sights, you also find the best restaurants, bars, theatres, shopping malls, pubs, ruin pubs, cafes, stores (do not forget to try our cakes!) etc. in the same neighbourhood. 
While you are very welcome to cook in the apartment Hungarian restaurants are so cheap and Hungarian dishes are so distinctive and delicious that I would rather recommend you sampling as many local dishes  such as lángos, as you can (if you need recommendations, I can definitely help out with that, you can also find some information booklets in the apartment). 

The apartment is meant to convey true cosmopolitan spirit: the entrance hall is called Budapest (what else??!), the two rooms which are rented temporarily are named after New York and Provance, These rooms have double beds so  they are suitable for two guests.  There are two bathrooms, one with a bath and another one with a shower. There is a separate toilet with a basin. We and all of my friends loved the kitchen and the dining room, we partied there a lot. 

In spite of the central location, there is peace and quiet, so it is important that you make sure that you do not disturb those who live there permanently and please  do not smoke on the corridor.  
The place is a perfect oasis for recreation but when you step out of the building you will love the contrast as you find yourself in a really lively city. If you enjoy walking, you can reach almost everything on foot. At the same time, public transportation is amazing in Budapest: it is cheap (buy a travel pass!) and takes you everywhere within minutes.

I hope you will be enjoying your stay as fully as you can. I would love to welcome you at my place. I speak fluent English, so there are no language barriers if you can speak some English too. Hope to hear from you soon.

PS.
I would also like to remind you that if you need a professional tour guide for a private tailor-made walking tour (it can be as short as half an hour or as long as you wish) or if you just want to get orientated in the area, I can do it for you. Besides, I am available for mini-Hungarian courses too so if you are interested in learning something about this very fascinating language, I can provide an overview or just teach you survival Hungarian or/and one or two folk songs;-). Send me an e-mail for private arrangements if you are interested in booking any of these additional services.
Now it is really time to say goodbye: I wish you safe travel, a good number of pleasant experiences, fantastic memories of our gorgeous city and a lot to write home about. See you soon!

name: Bagatelle Gardenhouse villa-hotelroom (Betű)
description:
This home-from-home hotel is unique in every detail: outstanding design and art are coupled with a sustainable approach, treats from the city’s best known breakfast spot and friendly service, all in a historic building enveloped by a beautiful garden.
A cozy, light space, what represents timeless elegance.
The breakfast is from the best breakfast place in town, the neighboring co-owned Villa Bagatelle.
We also offer unlimited non-alkoholic beverages, snacks and parking during your stay.
host_about:
Nagyon szeretjük Budapestet. Több mint 10 évvel ezelőtt nyitottuk meg egy pékséggel és egy bisztróval a Villa Bagatelle-t, ami mára a város egyik legkedveltebb ebéd és reggeliző helyévé vált. Amikor lehetőségünk lett rá, hogy megvegyük a szomszédban az 1936-ban épült villát, egy új álom vette kezdetét.

Egy olyan helyet álmodtunk meg, ahol mi magunk is szívesen szállnánk meg utazásaink során, ahol minden tárgynak története van, eklektikus és hangulatos, de legfőképpen nagyon otthonos. A tervezés során számos hozzánk közel álló, ismerős designert és művészt kértünk fel arra, hogy alkotásaikkal gazdagítsák a Gardenhouse tereit – az ő lelkes közreműködésük egyszerre volt inspiráló és megtisztelő, valódi ajándék és ihletforrás.

E sokféle egyéniség munkáiból, valamint kortárs designbútorokból, saját tárgyainkból, egyenként kiválasztott, különleges kiegészítőkből, és sok-sok odafigyelésből és szeretetből állt össze végül a Gardenhouse, amely egyszerre kikapcsol, feltölt és inspirál. Ha belép a villába, ennek a színes csapatnak a nyitott otthonába lép be a vendég.

A villa nem véletlenül kapta a Gardenhouse nevet, hiszen a kert itt főszereplő. Szobáink többsége és teraszaink is a kertre vagy az előkertre néznek – éppen azért, mert a kert a Gardenhouse talán legfontosabb eleme: ha úgy tetszik, a szíve-lelke.

Reméljük, hamarosan Önt is vendégeink között üdvözölhetjük! Szeretettel várjuk!

Wirtz Ágnes és Albrecht

name: Bagatelle Gardenhouse villa-hotelroom (Rapszódia)
description:
This home-from-home hotel is unique in every detail: outstanding design and art are coupled with a sustainable approach, treats from the city’s best known breakfast spot and friendly service, all in a historic building enveloped by a beautiful garden.
A cozy, light space, what represents timeless elegance.
The breakfast is from the best breakfast place in town, the neighboring co-owned Villa Bagatelle.
We also offer unlimited non-alkoholic beverages, snacks and parking during your stay.
host_about:
Nagyon szeretjük Budapestet. Több mint 10 évvel ezelőtt nyitottuk meg egy pékséggel és egy bisztróval a Villa Bagatelle-t, ami mára a város egyik legkedveltebb ebéd és reggeliző helyévé vált. Amikor lehetőségünk lett rá, hogy megvegyük a szomszédban az 1936-ban épült villát, egy új álom vette kezdetét.

Egy olyan helyet álmodtunk meg, ahol mi magunk is szívesen szállnánk meg utazásaink során, ahol minden tárgynak története van, eklektikus és hangulatos, de legfőképpen nagyon otthonos. A tervezés során számos hozzánk közel álló, ismerős designert és művészt kértünk fel arra, hogy alkotásaikkal gazdagítsák a Gardenhouse tereit – az ő lelkes közreműködésük egyszerre volt inspiráló és megtisztelő, valódi ajándék és ihletforrás.

E sokféle egyéniség munkáiból, valamint kortárs designbútorokból, saját tárgyainkból, egyenként kiválasztott, különleges kiegészítőkből, és sok-sok odafigyelésből és szeretetből állt össze végül a Gardenhouse, amely egyszerre kikapcsol, feltölt és inspirál. Ha belép a villába, ennek a színes csapatnak a nyitott otthonába lép be a vendég.

A villa nem véletlenül kapta a Gardenhouse nevet, hiszen a kert itt főszereplő. Szobáink többsége és teraszaink is a kertre vagy az előkertre néznek – éppen azért, mert a kert a Gardenhouse talán legfontosabb eleme: ha úgy tetszik, a szíve-lelke.

Reméljük, hamarosan Önt is vendégeink között üdvözölhetjük! Szeretettel várjuk!

Wirtz Ágnes és Albrecht

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

My motto is ' I live and breathe Budapest'

host_about:
More than twenty years ago, I was a conference manager, organizing conferences all over the world. That's how I discovered Budapest and its beauty. I peeped trough several windows of old abandoned buildings, dreaming to restore their majestic and refined beauty.  
Recently I went back and luckily the buildings are in a much better shape. I experienced its great atmosphere again and felt so attrackted that I decided to buy this apartment. I decorated it with care with the intention that every guest will experience  a sense of 'home'. 
For myself and for guests to share the beauty of the capital of Hungary, combined with the relaxed and open mentality of its inhabitants.
I've travelled all over the world, lived in Amsterdam for years and settled down  in Nijmegen where my two boys (13, 15) are born. Although they don't like crowded places, they love to stroll through Budapest as it is still a relaxed city. They'll tell you to eat Sushi at the Ráday utca and not to walk home before trying the delicious Italian icecream of Mamo (Ráday utca 24). 
Hope you'll love it too!

Host registration
According to the Hungarian Government Decrees 239/2009 and 383/2020, all providers of accommodations for guests must register and report their hosting activity through the National Tourism Data Centre (NTAK) operated by the Hungarian Tourism Agency.

Upon receipt of a registration request with all the required attachments, the Agency will add your accommodation in their register and issue a registration number to you. The NTAK regularly conducts a posteriori controls of registered accommodation to ensure compliance. In case of a failure to follow the registration and reporting rules, the Hungarian Tourism Agency may take action against infringing Hosts. This may include a warning, fines, or ordering a temporary closure of the accommodation as well as removal from their register.

I am Mihaly (or Misi in short), but you can call me Mike, as most of my foreign friends do. I was born and raised in Budapest, which I genuinely believe is one of the world's most beautiful and fun cities! It's a pleasure to share my city and experiences with people from all over the Globe.
I started hosting in 2011, and since 2015 I have managed the apartments as the head of a company (UandB), with a team who are just as dedicated and passionate about hosting and travel as I am. We also take great pride in our select portfolio: We only manage apartments that are up to high standards and where we would be glad to stay on our journey. We aim to combine hotel quality with a home-away-from-home touch, which was the hallmark of Airbnb back in the day.
Answering changes in traveler needs now, all of our apartments are self-check-in, but we still try to provide a personal experience to our guests according to their needs. We maintain proactive communication, guides, and services at our apartments and reply quickly and thoroughly to any question, request, or comment you might have. Feel free to contact us at any time! For absolute emergencies late at night, use our phone number. Otherwise, the best way to reach us is through here!

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

name: Charming apartment  in the heart of Gellért area.
description: Our recently renovated and lovely Zenta apartment, is located just in the beating heart of Budapest, just a few minutes walk away from the famous Gellért Baths or the Citadel. Yet at a very quiet location that will allow you to have the best rest after a long day strolling this beautiful city or a fun night out in the buzzing downtown. Just stepping out the doorstep you'll find an amazing variety of cafes bars and restaurants that will put you in the perfect mood to immerse in our city
host_about:
Hi, 

Hotel Linden has been open since 2015,  and in March 2019  we have reopened it after a full renovation. From kitchen to walls, repainted and deep cleaned every corner of the apartment.

We are more than happy to welcome you  in our modern, friendly hostel.
When you make a reservation I'm shortly going to send you all the details about the check in process, there is a self check in machine operates. 
So theres wouldn't be any problem if you would arrive late at night.

I'm Fanni Vas, i was born in 1991, Budapest.
After i finished high school i went to London for one year to work there and develop my english skills. 
Then I moved back and my family and I started to host guest in nice rooms in the central of Budapest. 
I was studying interior design and my father is a building contractor, so it was quite easy to create the flat together.

The apartment has 5 separated rooms all has private bathroom, all of them opens from the rooms. All the rooms has double bed, with fresh, brand new sheets and soft linens. 10 people can stay in the Hotel at one time. There are keys for each rooms. We also provide towels.

It also includes a fully fitted shared kitchen including fridge / freezer, electric cooker, microwave oven, kettle, cutlery, you also can ask for iron and hair dryer.

The building was used to be a part of the Hungarian Ceramics Association. 
It has a really lovely atmosphere, the whole house has only one floor, buildings like this are very rare in the downtown. 

The location is really good, Hársfa street is basically one street away from Budapest's main ring road Körút. The nearest tram stop is Wesselenyi str. (2 mins by walk) So everything is close and you can feel you're 
in heart of the capital, but you also can rest there because the street is quiet, peaceful and clean. One of the most famous theatre in Budapest (Madách Theatre)  has the artist door from this street, just on the opposite side of Hotel Linden.

Public Transports to Hotel Linden:
From the airport:

Take bus 200E from the airport till Kőbánya-Kispest  then metro 3 (blue line) to Corvin-negyed then 4/6tram (yellow one) get off at Wesselényi Street and walk a bit till Hársfa street (Takes a bit more than an hour)
Or take bus 100E- its a direct bus to the centre, you need to walk from Deák Ferenc square to Harsfa street (about 15mins by walk)

From Keleti railway station: Take bus 7E or simple 7 or 5 till Blaha Lujza tér from there 4/6tram (yellow one) and get off at Wesselényi Street and walk a bit till Hársfa street (Takes 20 mins usually)

From Népliget international bus station:
Get on the metro 3 (blue line) to Corvinn-negyed then 4/6tram (yellow one) get off at Wesselényi Street and walk a bit till Hársfa street (Takes 30 mins)

I like to meet new people and help them to get to know my hometown, which is so interesting and beautiful.
You always can contact me, feel free anytime!
Looking forward to meet you in person!

Fanni

host_about:
Dear Guests,

I am Mihaly (or Misi in short), but you can call me Mike, as most of my foreign friends do. I was born and raised in Budapest, which I genuinely believe is one of the world's most beautiful and fun cities! It's a pleasure to share my city and experiences with people from all over the Globe.

We also take great pride in our select portfolio: We only manage apartments that are up to high standards and where we would be glad to stay on our journey. We aim to combine hotel quality with a home-away-from-home touch, which was the hallmark of Airbnb back in the day.
Answering changes in traveler needs now, all of our apartments are self-check-in, but we still try to provide a personal experience to our guests according to their needs. We maintain proactive communication, guides, and services at our apartments and reply quickly and thoroughly to any question, request, or comment you might have. Feel free to contact us at any time! For absolute emergencies late at night, use our phone number. Otherwise, the best way to reach us is through here!

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

host_about:
I love traveling, get to know new people, culture, try new things and gain new experience. I believe every person and place can open up new perspectives for us, so I like understanding everyone, their opinion and ideas, wherever I am.

I have heard lots of stories. Sad ones, happy ones that made me empathize with them, reflect it to my life and re-live the others’ experience. That is why I think connecting with each other is so important.

name: Our Magic Shelter@AC & Garden & Vinyls & Local art
description: IF YOU:♥are a free spirit looking for an authentic shelter;♥love VINYLS;♥want to sit under TREES in the middle of the capital;♥need a HOME OFFICE with COMFY DESK and super fast WIFI;♥need a YOGA MAT for your practice;♥want to enjoy a fully equipped HOME with COOKING abilities & WASHING MACHINE? SEARCH NO MORE, you have found your space! With my wife we created this interior by our  own hands, in the name of upcycling and the love of authentic Budapest style. Welcome to our FUNKY URBAN PARADISE!
host_about:
Hello Universe! 

I am Nandor, an interior reconstructor in my early 30's. Me and my wife Dorka are running our short-term rental business over 8 years- we are running 6 apartments in the heart of Budapest. We live and love in the IXth district of Budapest, Hungary with our baby son Vazul and our little dog Bogi. (so of course we are a baby and dog friendly accomodation!) We started to dive into the hosting experience 10 years ago, when we started to use the hospitality exchange sites which are not allowed to mentioned by name here ;) / Club of hospitality & Surfing Couches community/ In the last 10 years we have hosted around 60-70 people on our couch to share experience and get to know other cultures. When we both finished our university studies, we didn't want to sit in an office but continue to meet with lovely people from around the world. That was the beginning of this little family company which we are running together. Officially I have 3 apartments at Budapest Elisabeth avenue and Dorka has 2 apartments at Akácfa street, all of them in the famous VII.th Jewish District.  We manage the apartments together, and we also help Dorka's brother, László to manage his airbnb listing as well. So all together, we run 6 airbnb's, which takes almost all of our time :) As these homes together can accomodate up to 20 people- let us known if you are planning a big company holiday. We can sort that out too!

We are very proud that we renovated and decorated all of our apartments by our own hands. As I am real handyman and can build or fix anything (apart from electric stuff-- i wouldnt dare to touch those, hahaa), and Dorka is a talented DIY lady and wannabe interior designer, all of our homes are unique and authentic. That means we use as few ikea stuff as we can, and we prefer re-cycled and up-cycled items. We often collect furnitures from the streets to fix them, re-paint them and give them a new life in our enterior. We belive that hand made furnitures do have a soul. 

Usually Dorka is the one who is connecting with guests, organising reservations, and I am maintaining all of the 6 apartments. In the first years we cleaned the apartments by ourselves, but when the baby has arrived 3 years ago, we decided to hire a great cleaning company.

It is possible that we won’t meet in person, as we are creating our big dream- to move to the countryside. We have a little wooden cottage at Lake Balaton, and we are doing our best to build a house there. Therefore we spend half of our time there at the lake to work hard on our project. 

But not meeting in person doesn’t mean you will be lacking support. Firstly, you can check in by yourself, which makes your travel much easier than having a schedueled arrival time. You will receive all the neccessary info through airbnb messenger. Secondly, in all of our apartment you will find a long leaflet about the accomodation and about things to do in the city- so you will have all the neccesary infos to have an amazing and balanced holiday in Budapest! And of course, we are always just an email away ;)

As we mentioned, we love to be in nature, and often go to the Lake Balaton. We desire to hide ourselves from the world at that little piece of magic land. We also experienced that more and more international tourists would want to go on a 1-2 day trip to the Balaton (which is world wide famous of its wine and sailing culture). This year we bought a 9 person VW van, so we can easily arrange a day trip outside of the crowded city. Just let us known what do you have in mind, surely we can find a way to make it come true!

We speak english confidently, and Dorka speaks several words in russian and in german also. We are looking forward to welcome you in the heart of Budapest, lets create the magic together!

Peace on earth

Nándor and Dorka

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

Mike and the whole UandB team

host_about:
Budapest is the perfect destination for a weekend city trip. Budapest is the spa capital with over 100 thermal springs beneath the city that supply the famous baths. you can rest your leg in the thermal pools of a unique 16th and 17th- century Turkish baths or the neo-baroque Széchenyi bath.

Also unique to Europe are Budapest's ruin pubs. Located in the city centre, this new function saved the countless old, run-down building from demolition. Their atmosphere is unusual, their style is retro and they revive socialist realist interior design. 

And while you are here don’t forget to try out the best of Hungary’s cuisine: a gulash, a stew, a strudel, and a pancake.

host_about:
Dear Guests,

We maintain proactive communication, guides, and services at our apartments and reply quickly and thoroughly to any question, request, or comment you might have. Feel free to contact us at any time! We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

Dear Guests,

I am Mihaly (or Misi in short), but you can call me Mike, as most of my foreign friends do. I was born and raised in Budapest, which I genuinely believe is one of the world's most beautiful and fun cities! It's a pleasure to share my city and experiences with people from all over the Globe.
I started hosting in 2011, and since 2015 I have managed the apartments as the head of a company (UandB), with a team who are just as dedicated and passionate about hosting and travel as I am. We also take great pride in our select portfolio: We only manage apartments that are up to high standards and where we would be glad to stay on our journey. We aim to combine hotel quality with a home-away-from-home touch, which was the hallmark of Airbnb back in the day.
Answering changes in traveler needs now, all of our apartments are self-check-in, but we still try to provide a personal experience to our guests according to their needs. We maintain proactive communication, guides, and services at our apartments and reply quickly and thoroughly to any question, request, or comment you might have. Feel free to contact us at any time! For absolute emergencies late at night, use our phone number. Otherwise, the best way to reach us is through here!

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

name: Hidden Gem by the Ruin Bars and Historic Streets
description: Discover the vibrant heart of Budapest from this spacious 6-guest apartment, the perfect base for exploring the city! Just a short walk from the Dohány Street Synagogue, Astoria, Gozsdu Courtyard, and the famous ruin bars. Nearby, you'll find excellent restaurants, cozy cafés, and shops, while Deák Square and metro stations provide easy access to the entire city. host_about:
I love traveling, get to know new people, culture, try new things and gain new experience. I believe every person and place can open up new perspectives for us, so I like understanding everyone, their opinion and ideas, wherever I am.

Mike and the whole UandB team

Mike and the whole UandB team

Mike and the whole UandB team

Mike and the whole UandB team

I am Mihaly (or Misi in short), but you can call me Mike, as most of my foreign friends do. I was born and raised in Budapest, which I genuinely believe is one of the world's most beautiful and fun cities! It's a pleasure to share my city and experiences with people from all over the Globe.
I started hosting in 2011, and since 2015 I have managed the apartments as the head of a company (UandB), with a team who are just as dedicated and passionate about hosting and travel as I am. We also take great pride in our select portfolio: We only manage apartments that are up to high standards and where we would be glad to stay on our journey. We aim to combine hotel quality with a home-away-from-home touch, which was the hallmark of Airbnb back in the day.
Answering changes in traveler needs now, all of our apartments are self-check-in, but we still try to provide a personal experience to our guests according to their needs. We maintain proactive communication, guides, and services at our apartments and reply quickly and thoroughly to any question, request, or comment you might have. Feel free to contact us at any time! For absolute emergencies late at night, use our phone number. Otherwise, the best way to reach us is through here!

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

host_about:
Hello World, this is Béla!

Once upon a time when Airbnb didn’t exist… Me and my friends loved to travel and stay at private places, see the world and get mesmerized by authentic experiences. Some years ago I started the reverse, to welcome guests in my own apartment. Welcome to the Grand Danube Duplex w/ Balcony, a spacious 4-bedroom home offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Danube River. Designed across two levels, this stylish apartment combines comfort and elegance, with a large balcony perfect for morning coffee or sunset drinks.

Located in the heart of Budapest, you’ll enjoy easy access to the city’s best restaurants, cafes, and cultural landmarks. Ideal for families, groups, or anyone looking for space, style, and unforgettable views.
host_about:
Dear Guests,

I am Mihaly (or Misi in short), but you can call me Mike, as most of my foreign friends do. I was born and raised in Budapest, which I genuinely believe is one of the world's most beautiful and fun cities! It's a pleasure to share my city and experiences with people from all over the Globe.
I started hosting in 2011, and since 2015 I have managed the apartments as the head of a company (UandB), with a team who are just as dedicated and passionate about hosting and travel as I am. We also take great pride in our select portfolio: We only manage apartments that are up to high standards and where we would be glad to stay on our journey. We aim to combine hotel quality with a home-away-from-home touch, which was the hallmark of Airbnb back in the day.
Answering changes in traveler needs now, all of our apartments are self-check-in, but we still try to provide a personal experience to our guests according to their needs. We maintain proactive communication, guides, and services at our apartments and reply quickly and thoroughly to any question, request, or comment you might have. Feel free to contact us at any time! For absolute emergencies late at night, use our phone number. Otherwise, the best way to reach us is through here!

We are looking forward to hosting you!

Mike and the whole UandB team

Also unique to Europe are Budapest's ruin pubs. Located in the city centre, this new function saved the countless old, run-down building from demolition. Their atmosphere is unusual, their style is retro and they revive socialist realist interior design. 

And while you are here don’t forget to try out the best of Hungary’s cuisine: a gulash, a stew, a strudel, and a pancake.
